description: dependencyDashboard restates the global setting in config.js rather than inheriting it, the same way prConcurrentLimit and recreateWhen are restated in the other managed repositories. A repository's own config is merged over the global one, and the config:recommended below extends :dependencyDashboard, so without this line the preset turns the dashboard back on for this repository alone. Stated as a plain key rather than by adding :disableDependencyDashboard to extends, because a key set outside extends wins over the presets regardless of the order they are listed in.

packageRules.description: Everything updated here is CI tooling that the Validate workflow runs on the pull request that bumps it, so a broken version fails a required check rather than reaching main. Majors are left out: the one that matters is renovatebot/github-action, and a major of the thing that updates every managed repository is worth a person looking at. Stated in full rather than leaning on the patch-only rule in config.js, so this does not depend on whether packageRules concatenate or replace when the global config is merged with this one.
